policies.sweep20: at original monthly signal close cap each equity_crisis/gold book share at20%; no loss replenishment; remainder reserve
policies.cap40: at original monthly signal close cap each equity_crisis/gold book share at40%; no loss replenishment; remainder reserve
policies.active20: monthly closed source target contains positive non-BIL weight =>20% book share, otherwise zero; remainder reserve; explicit recapitalization when active
policies.scope: shares frozen at original monthly closed decision and filled after original delay; continuous cap not claimed; original source target stream unchanged; gross per-book fees including opposite fills
policies.profit: capital transfers sum zero and excluded from profit; three initial shares20/20/60; no new yield sources

dsr_pbo: not calculated; global trial count unreconciled; history consumed

selection_policy.primary: maximize minimum cash_excess_sharpe across all four cost/delay cells
selection_policy.ties: minimum CAGR, worst drawdown, lower maximum turnover, stable version ID

inverse_ETF_model: SH/PSQ/TBF actual adjusted open/close prices; long units of daily inverse funds, including embedded expenses and daily compounding; no synthetic minus-index returns
previously_consumed_later_data: Fifth-round July31..Sep30 equity and September crypto observations already inspected; no new independent later check in this round
missing_asset_policy: All ETH/PAXG segments resolved by decision-day available full history; never choose a latest future segment or fill gaps
fundamental_scope: No broader fundamental claim from price/liquidity proxies. Previous issued-supply/fee data already consumed and limited. Funding/basis/staking require new point-in-time histories and proper signed/margin accounting; not fabricated into this spot experiment
stop_policy: One frozen run of10 candidates, all72 curves retained; no parameter rescue after seeing returns; preserve failed artifact for a separately documented implementation revision.
structural_question: Separate risk exit from causal risk recovery; distribute realized source capital under declared profit sweep, monthly cap and activation rules.
accounting: Actual long spot and fund units; cash and gross book trade fees explicit. Capital transfers net zero and excluded from book profits. Closed crypto episodes and capital source net contributions separately reconciled.

c60.transition: nominal weight zero or absent at previous close to positive at decision close; no new thresholds, no return-conditioned recovery
c60.all: transition in any asset triggers full-book rebalance in addition to weekly buys
c60.core: only BTC/ETH transitions trigger full-book rebalance in addition to weekly buys
c60.staged: any transition triggers full-book rebalance with recovered asset weight halved outside Sunday; next closed session if still positive permits full-book refill; Sunday overrides staging
c60.scoped: weekly full-book buys; other days vintage reductions then purchases only in recovered assets; unchanged other units frozen, cash-funded; covariance applied to combined planned weights
c60.stale: all recovery candidates cancel positive full-book weights if latest t-1 nominal weight is zero; scoped recoveries also cancel stale acquisition
c60.lag: closed decision t, execution t+1+extra delay; never execution-day close
